messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: detected elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate across eu-west-1 (5m avg 8% -> 22%). Paging oncall sophie.

sophie: seeing it, joining. pulling up traces and logs now.

maya: i can take a look at routing/traffic if you want to focus on kernels.

sophie: yes pls. first quick check: are we seeing backpressure on the inferencer pool or an upstream auth issue?

raj: logs show a spike of `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` from model-worker-42 and also a flurry of 504s from the batching router. snippet: ```
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z model-worker-42 ERROR RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
2026-03-15T09:02:13Z batching-router WARN request dropped after 30s
```

sophie: ok. sounds like a kernel/memory pressure event causing timeouts. rolling a quick mitigation: scale up dedicated pool + reduce max_batch_size for the affected model.

ops-bot: scale request accepted: +3 workers to pool infer-dedicated-eu (ETA 80s).

maya: reduced max_batch_size from 16 -> 8 in canary config for model v2-quant. patch: `deploy config set model.v2.quant.batch.max=8 --env eu-west-1 --canary`.

leo: pinging product to slack customers who reported errors (we have two active support tickets).

harper: highlighting potential billing impact if retries happen. we'll need rough minutes of outage and impacted requests for finance later.

sophie: traffic routing change applied: fallback to smaller-quant variant for ~15% of requests while we stabilize. monitoring latency/5xx.

raj: after scale and batching tweak, 5xx dropped to 2% in the last 3m. rolling back canary to full if stable for 5m.

ops-bot: autoscale complete. +3 workers healthy.

sophie: keeping thread open for post-incident follow-up. action items inline: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) RCA on memory regression after model update, 3) revert plan for quantization defaults, 4) customer impact incl. request counts and SLA exposure, 5) finance calc for potential SLA credit. assigning below.

maya: i'll take RCA on routing/batching interactions.

raj: i'll dive into worker OOM stack and kernel changes from last deploy.

leo: i'll coordinate with support for affected customers and draft customer comms.

harper: i'll calculate estimated billing adjustments. need total impacted tokens and minutes of elevated error/retries. pls add those numbers to the postmortem doc when ready.

sophie: scheduling postmortem meeting: default to tomorrow 10:00 UTC unless anyone objects. agenda: timeline, root cause, mitigation timeline, action owners, SLA exposure. who can't make it?

maya: can do.

raj: ok.

leo: ok.

harper: ok.

incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem doc and tag with severity and customer impact. Use template: /pm new --severity=sev2 --impact="customer-facing errors"

sophie: created doc: https://docs.internal.redwood.pm/pms/INC-1890001111 (add mitigation graphs + query results). i've pasted query for error-window below:```
-- tokens: count of requests with status >=500 between 2026-03-15T09:00 and 2026-03-15T09:20
SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE status >= 500 AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-15T09:00' AND '2026-03-15T09:20' AND region='eu-west-1';
```

raj: results: 12,430 failed requests in the 20m window. average request size ~350 tokens.

harper: rough calc for finance: if 12,430 requests * 350 tokens = ~4,350,500 tokens. we'll need to know how many were retried successfully (double-charge risk) and what our SLA formula applies (percent error over 99.5% = credit).

leo: support thread shows 2 customers with high volume affected (customer-A and customer-B). customer-A reported increased latency and partial failures for 12 minutes; customer-B noted intermittent 5xx for ~18 minutes.

sophie: recording action items in doc and assigning owners. also adding temporary rollback to safer quant defaults as a 24h mitigation, assigned to raj.

maya: one proposed follow-up: add a pre-deploy stress test that simulates OOM scenarios for quantized models. assigning to me.

harper: finance needs final numbers for tokens, retry counts, and minutes of SLA breach to compute credits. once postmortem has those fields filled, i'll open an accounting ticket.

sophie: scheduling complete: postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC — invite sent. please paste your findings in the doc before the meeting so finance/product can calculate credits.

ops-bot: deploys are green for remaining canaries. incident thread will be archived after PM publishes final postmortem.

leo: follow-up: customer-A asked for an estimate of SLA credit today. i'll coordinate with harper and share conservative numbers after finance calc.

harper: noted. i'll prioritize accounting ticket after postmortem.

sophie: closing loop for ops: if we see repeat in 24h, escalate to sev1 and open immediate rollback. for now monitoring 4h. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all. great coordination.

incident-bot: Thread status: resolved -> monitoring. tags: [oom, batching, quantization, sla-review].
